active_problem: Production Streamlit intermittently displayed 'Kyre Sports API request unavailable: ReadTimeout' even after the prior history-pool and one-retry repairs. The public Passing Yards slate overlay still ran verified NFL context work and per-game sportsbook market work sequentially, while market collection had no slate-level aggregate deadline. A single slow game-market request could therefore hold the entire 28-QB slate beyond the frontend read budget.
solution: Keep the verified lower-layer model/data implementation unchanged. In the public Passing Yards successor overlay, start verified NFL context prefetch and sportsbook market prefetch concurrently, and bound the entire game-market fanout to a 6-second aggregate deadline. Preserve completed market results; cancel or semantically degrade unfinished market fields to empty observations so verified stats/history remain renderable. Do not increase the frontend timeout.

routing_contract.market_secondary: The Odds API when configured and needed
routing_contract.provider_failure_scope: A slow market request may degrade only its market field; it must not block unrelated verified stats/history.

tdd.red: 2/2 R2 regressions failed on untouched baseline: no bounded market-prefetch API existed and the public slate overlay started context/market work sequentially.
tdd.green: 2/2 R2 regressions passed after the overlay-only implementation.
tdd.baseline_comparison: Untouched Passing Yards wildcard baseline: 46 failed / 366 passed. R2 patched comparable suite: 44 failed / 368 passed. R2 introduced zero new legacy failures.

verification.pre_fix_live_measurement: One controlled production request returned HTTP 200, ready=true, 28 QBs in 7.255s; the user screenshot proves the failure is intermittent rather than a permanently unavailable API.
verification.root_cause: FanDuel market lookup can perform multiple individually bounded provider calls per game, while the public slate previously waited on all game-market futures without an aggregate deadline and only started that phase after context/history work completed.
verification.implementation_scope: Only sports_api/api/nfl_passing_yards_slate_v1/__init__.py plus the R2 regression test; the verified lower-layer slate implementation remains unchanged.
verification.source_policy: GREEN — Kyre Sports API only; no SGO/ESPN/ESPN BET; no fabricated lines; no missing-to-zero; no sportsbook averaging.
